title: A morphism of distinguished triangles with two isomorphic components is an isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a pre-triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] and let $(a,b,c)$ be a morphism from a distinguished triangle $X\to Y\to Z\to X[1]$ to a distinguished triangle $X'\to Y'\to Z'\to X'[1]$ (so the three squares commute, the last with $a[1]$). If two of $a,b,c$ are isomorphisms, so is the third.
